structure_evidence.agency_relation:
Predicted outcomes for control are homogeneous: every command I might issue results in selecting the lower location next. Thus I have little ability to redirect attention within this view—commands converge to the low-recoverability lower item.

Predicted control is strong: commands steer selection to their named locations (upper→upper, right→right, lower→lower, left→left). Redirecting attention in B reliably selects the commanded item; recoverability of that item will depend on its own recoverability estimates, not on selection alone.
